# P37.26 — Graph explorer A (K2 GX-09a)

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/450_P37.26__graph-explorer-a.md` (row 450, `R11-K13-GX-09a`)
**Base:** `r11/P37.25-overview-builder-b` · **Harness:** devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent

## What lands

- **`/explore/` — the T2 graph explorer's first wave** (`web/src/pages/explore/index.astro`
  + `web/src/islands/ExploreIsland.tsx`): the P37.17-registered surface ships.
  The SSR first paint carries the C-16 honest equivalent — the overview index,
  the default overview's static figure + bounded adjacency preview, the
  access-edge legend and three unmerged groups, partner counts, and the
  access-path closure (per-hop evidence, SPECULATIVE beyond 3 hops,
  SIG-UI-120) — inside a reserved box the island upgrades. The island is
  **Preact + sigma + graphology** (ADR-242): `overview=` picks the
  `sig.graph-overview/1` doc (fetched from `/graph/<ov>/<comp>.json`,
  `decodeOverview` + `mergeOverviews`), `focus=` selects a node
  (aria-pressed + detail panel → entity page), edge panels name
  relation/date/currency/sources/evidence and hand off to entity pages and
  the static adjacency in ≤ 2 actions (→ provenance). Workspace state
  round-trips `sig.workspace-state/2` (SIG-UI-119 — `useMapWorkspace("network")`),
  `cite-this-view` mints `/s/<pub>/explore/?v=2&…`, and the GX-09b-reserved
  params (`edge`/`expand`/`hops`/`path`/`jurisdiction`/`technology`/`q`…)
  render the SIG-UI-060 unapplied notice — parsed, never applied. The
  centrality-withdrawn note ships (SIG-UI-121).
- **`/network/` retirement:** 301 to `/explore/?v=2&overview=access` —
  the access overview is the successor surface; selector query params merge
  onto the target's own query (`redirects.conf` `if ($args)` branch). The
  page-type registry drops the `/network/` row (a stray emission fails the
  build); `SURFACE_PATHS.graph` + v1 `WORKSPACE_VIEW_PATHS` → `/explore/`,
  `APPLIED_PARAMS.graph` gains `overview`; nav, `ops/public_routes.toml`,
  the post-cutover fixtures, `ROUTES.csv` (R17 retired / R37 resolves),
  `exports/release_pages.py` `SITE_NAV` and both AGENTS.md files follow.
- **UXK0-6's last migration — react leaves the public bundles:**
  `@astrojs/react`, `react`/`react-dom` + types out of `package.json`;
  `ProvenancePanel.tsx` → Preact; `sigma@3.0.3` + `graphology@0.26.0` join
  `runtime-deps.json` `browser` (ADR-242 admits them — ADR-155 amended).
  **The bundle-content gate lands** (the last of UXK0-6):
  `check-runtime-deps.mjs` scans every emitted `dist/_astro/*.js` for a
  react/compat signature (`react-dom`, `createPortal`, `preact/compat`,
  the shared-internals marker) and fails the build on a hit; the island
  graphs' bare specifiers stay allow-listed (ExploreIsland joins the roots).
- **Tests:** new `tests/e2e/explore.spec.ts` (mount, overview picker
  round-trip, overview miss, node panel, deep-linked focus + miss, edge
  panel → provenance, unapplied-facet notice, the cite mint, no-JS
  equivalents, centrality abstention, J2 web leg); the `/network/` e2e
  corpus retargeted (`/explore/`) with assertions preserved where the
  static sections moved verbatim; unit specs updated (nav, explore-links,
  workspace-state v1+v2, page-types, redirects, lhci-generated,
  release-routes); the root-absolute-paths baseline's `/network/` seats
  retargeted to `/explore/` (the baseline only shrinks — count holds at 9).
- **Records:** ADR-242 (+ ADR_TRIGGERS row, BL-087 sources, generated
  index); `docs/build/runs/P37.26.md` run ledger.
